title: An Exact Fold Condition for Mass-Balanced Models of Protein Quality Control: analysis code
description: Derivation, verification and numerical study of the fold condition of a finite-resource proteostasis clearance network. Accompanies the manuscript of the same name. Every reported number is recomputable from the tracked scripts; see DECISIONS.md for the decision log and notes/POSTDICTION_PROTOCOL.md for the empirical-contact protocol.
